test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The teacher made __judicious__ use of technology to explain a sensitive topic.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. prudent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"judicious"** means having, showing, or done with good judgment or sense. (विवेकपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The company's judicious use of resources led to its rapid growth.
 
 
 
• **"Prudent"** refers to acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example: **It is prudent to save money for unexpected expenses.
